name: Category - Default (seed v1)
description: A group of item blueprints (Weapons, Armor, Food, ...), optionally inside a parent category. Categories filter the in-game item catalogue and decide which items a lootbox type can drop.

steps.description: Name the category and place it in the category tree. Items are put in a category on the item blueprint form.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Shown to players as a filter value in the item catalogue, so keep it short and unique.

fields.label: Parent category
fields.description: Makes this a subcategory (e.g. Swords under Weapons). A lootbox type set to include subcategories also drops items from here. Leave empty for a top-level category; never pick one of its own subcategories.

fields.label: Icon
fields.description: The Minecraft item that represents this category where categories are shown with an icon. Optional.

steps.description: Labels that describe every item in this category. Add each with Create New Join Entry; create the tag itself on the tag form first.

fields.label: Tags
fields.description: For grouping and searching only: game rules such as "Lootbox Special" read the item's own tags, not its category's.
